title: Software Development Engineer in Test II
description:
TechGrove is the **Centre of Excellence** for Banyan Software, based in Chennai, India. It plays a key role in supporting Banyan's global businesses through technology, security, and software development. TechGrove brings together India's deep pool of technical talent with Banyan's long\-term approach to growth, creating a trusted, developer\-focused environment where people can do their best work.



About Element34  

Element34 is building modern enterprise solutions for software quality and test automation. Our  

flagship product, SBOX, helps enterprises run their Selenium, Playwright and Appium tests  

securely within their own infrastructure, behind their firewall and within their security and  

compliance boundaries.

  

We are part of Banyan Software, a long\-term owner of profitable vertical software businesses.  

Element34 operates with a lean engineering organization, giving engineers the opportunity to  

work closely with product, customers and leadership and see the direct impact of their work.



About SBOX  

SBOX is an enterprise test automation platform that enables organizations to run browser and  

mobile automation at scale within their own environment.  

The platform supports Selenium, Playwright and Appium and includes capabilities around test  

execution, browser/device management, reporting, integrations and AI\-powered quality  

capabilities.  

We are continuing to evolve SBOX into a more AI\-native quality engineering platform, making  

reliability, automation intelligence and actionable quality insights an important part of the  

product.



The Opportunity  

We are looking for a SDET / Quality Engineer who wants to play a key role in building the next  

generation of quality engineering for SBOX.  

As our product and engineering velocity grow, we want to make quality an integral part of how we  

build and release software — not something that happens only at the end of the development  

cycle.  

You will help us build stronger automation, improve regression confidence, identify quality risks  

earlier and create better ways of understanding and resolving failures.  

This is a high\-ownership engineering role. You will have the freedom to identify opportunities,  

propose solutions and take them from idea to implementation.  

You won't just be executing predefined test cases — you'll help shape how quality engineering  

works at SBOX.



What You'll Work On  

Automation \& Quality Engineering  

* Design, build and maintain robust automation for critical SBOX workflows.
* Develop automation using Playwright, Appium and Selenium.
* Translate product requirements, user stories and customer workflows into meaningful


automated scenarios.  

* Build reusable automation components and frameworks that scale with the product.
* Continuously improve regression coverage and test reliability.


Test Execution \& Failure Analysis  

* Build and maintain automated workflows that run reliably in CI and unattended


environments.  

* Work with platforms such as BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, LambdaTest or equivalent.
* Analyze test results and investigate failures across application, automation, infrastructure


and environment.  

* Debug failures deeply and drive them through to resolution.
* Identify and eliminate flaky tests and recurring sources of instability.


Quality Strategy  

* Partner with engineers and product managers early in the development lifecycle.
* Help define the right testing strategy for new features and major product initiatives.
* Identify edge cases, integration risks and potential regression areas.
* Contribute to release\-readiness decisions using meaningful quality signals.
* Continuously improve our automation architecture, testing practices and tooling.


Test Management \& Defect Management  

* Create and maintain test cases, workflows and regression suites.
* Track execution progress and manage defects through their lifecycle.
* Participate in defect triaging and collaborate with Engineering and Product teams.
* Improve visibility into automation health, product quality and release confidence.


What We're Looking For  

Must Have  

* Strong experience in SDET, QA Automation or Quality Engineering.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Playwright and Appium
* Experience with Real\-device/mobile testing
* Strong programming skills in Java, JavaScript/TypeScript or another programming


language.  

* Hands\-on experience with platforms such as BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, LambdaTest or


equivalent.  

* Experience building or maintaining automation frameworks.
* Experience converting requirements and user stories into automated test scenarios.
* Experience running automation in unattended/CI environments.
* Strong debugging, problem\-solving and failure\-analysis skills.
* Experience with test management, defect tracking and triaging.
* Experience working in a startup, scale\-up or lean engineering environment.
* Strong sense of ownership and ability to execute independently.
* Experience with AI testing and quality engineering, AI\-assisted coding tools


Nice to Have  

* API testing and automation
* Accessibility testing
* Visual regression testing
* Performance/load testing
* Docker and Kubernetes
* CI/CD platforms
* Enterprise software and security\-focused environments


How We Work  

We are a small, experienced and highly collaborative engineering team. Our size gives every  

engineer the opportunity to have a meaningful impact.  

We value:  

* Ownership — Take a problem from understanding through implementation and outcomes.
* Initiative — We appreciate people who identify opportunities and proactively make things


better.  

* Independent execution — You will have autonomy to decide how to solve problems while


having support when you need it.  

* Engineering excellence — We care about building maintainable solutions, not just getting


a test to pass once.  

* Speed and pragmatism — We move quickly, learn quickly and continuously improve.


Because we operate with a lean structure, you will have broad ownership and visibility into your  

work. You won't be limited to a narrowly defined QA function — you'll collaborate across  

Engineering and Product and have the opportunity to influence how we build quality into SBOX. ***Recruitment Notice***



TechGrove may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in screening and/or assessing applicants during the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by our team. Personal information submitted through your application will be collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. Contact us at any time with questions about our process or to request accommodation.


***Beware of Recruitment Scams***



We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment.


**Protect yourself by following these steps:**


* Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an **@banyansoftware.com** email address.
* Remember, employers will **never** request payment or banking information during the hiring process.
* If you receive a suspicious message, **do not respond** — instead, forward it to careers@banyansoftware.com and/or report it to the platform where you received it.


Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.

**Position Summary**


The **Engineer 2, Occupational Safety** is responsible for supporting and implementing occupational health and safety programs across plant operations. Working under general supervision, the incumbent applies established safety engineering principles, technical standards, and regulatory requirements to identify, evaluate, and mitigate workplace hazards. The role provides operational safety support across all shifts, ensures compliance with statutory and company safety requirements, and contributes to a proactive safety culture through risk management, incident prevention, emergency preparedness, and continuous improvement initiatives.


The position supports the organization's Safety Operating System (SOS) and collaborates closely with Production, Maintenance, Security, Contractors, and Safety Workmen to ensure a safe and compliant work environment.


**A. Shift Safety Management**
------------------------------


* Ensure comprehensive safety coverage across all shifts (General/A/B/C) by deploying and supervising Safety Workmen in critical and high\-risk operational areas.
* Conduct shift handover briefings covering ongoing safety concerns, permit status, hot work activities, incidents, and unresolved safety observations.
* Perform routine shop\-floor safety inspections and patrols at defined intervals and document findings.
* Monitor and enforce compliance with Permit\-to\-Work (PTW) requirements for:
	+ Hot Work
	+ Confined Space Entry
	+ Work at Height
	+ Electrical Isolation (LOTO)
	+ Excavation Activities
* Identify unsafe conditions and initiate immediate corrective actions.

**B. Safety Workmen Supervision**
---------------------------------


* Allocate Safety Workmen based on operational risk assessments, manpower availability, and critical work activities.
* Monitor attendance, effectiveness, PPE compliance, and performance of Safety Workmen throughout the shift.
* Provide guidance and training on:
	+ Fire watch duties
	+ Gas testing procedures
	+ Barricading and access control
	+ Emergency response protocols
* Review shift reports submitted by Safety Workmen and escalate critical observations promptly.
* Deliver on\-the\-job coaching and periodic refresher training to strengthen safety competencies.

**C. Incident and Emergency Management**
----------------------------------------


* Serve as the first responder and safety coordinator during accidents, near misses, fires, medical emergencies, or other critical events.
* Ensure timely emergency response actions, including:
	+ First aid coordination
	+ Evacuation management
	+ Firefighting response
	+ Emergency communication
* Lead preliminary incident investigations and root cause analysis.
* Document incidents and recommend corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Support implementation and verification of incident closure actions.

**D. Compliance and Safety Documentation**
------------------------------------------


* Ensure compliance with:
	+ Factories Act and applicable State Factory Rules
	+ Indian statutory EHS regulations
	+ ISO 45001 requirements
	+ Internal company safety standards and procedures
* Maintain and update:
	+ PTW records
	+ Safety logbooks
	+ Gas testing reports
	+ Incident registers
	+ Compliance documentation
* Verify that all contractors and new employees have completed required safety inductions before entering operational areas.
* Exercise stop\-work authority when unsafe conditions or behaviors are observed.
* Issue safety observations, violation notices, and corrective actions as required by company procedures.
* Support planning, coordination, and execution of emergency drills including fire, evacuation, and medical response simulations.
* Conduct periodic inspections of emergency and safety equipment, including:
	+ Fire extinguishers
	+ First aid kits
	+ Eye wash stations
	+ Emergency response equipment

**E. Hazard Identification and Risk Control**
---------------------------------------------


* Monitor and drive adherence to 5S and workplace housekeeping standards.
* Ensure fire exits, emergency routes, assembly points, and safety signage remain unobstructed and compliant.
* Verify proper storage, handling, transportation, and labeling of hazardous materials and chemicals.
* Conduct hazard identification exercises and workplace risk assessments.
* Develop, implement, and track corrective and preventive actions to eliminate identified risks.

**F. Coordination and Reporting**
---------------------------------


* Coordinate with Production, Maintenance, Engineering, Utilities, Security, and Contractors to ensure safe execution of all plant activities.
* Prepare and submit daily and shift\-end safety reports, metrics, and MIS updates.
* Participate in daily safety reviews, toolbox talks, and operational meetings.
* Escalate safety concerns, manpower shortages, equipment failures, and compliance risks to Safety Management in a timely manner.
* Support safety improvement projects and contribute toward departmental safety objectives and milestones.

* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering.
* Master's Degree (M.Tech.) in Industrial Safety Engineering.

**Preferred**


* Additional certifications in Occupational Health \& Safety, Fire Safety, Risk Assessment, ISO 45001, or related EHS disciplines.

**Professional Experience**

**Required**


* 5 to 6 years of hands\-on Occupational Safety experience in manufacturing, automotive, heavy engineering, process, or industrial environments.
* Proven field\-based safety management experience involving shop\-floor operations, hazard identification, risk assessment, incident investigation, emergency response, and statutory compliance.
* Experience managing high\-risk activities including Permit\-to\-Work (PTW), LOTO, confined space entry, work at height, hot work, and contractor safety management.
* Experience supervising Safety Workmen, safety inspections, audits, and shift\-based safety operations.

**Preferred**

Own and extend the accuracy, completeness, and usability of the service management platform's data — so implementation teams and AI\-driven capabilities can act on it directly, and so priority consumers like vulnerability and exposure management run on complete, trustworthy ground truth. Service mapping and asset data are the anchor domain and immediate priority; the durable mandate is data quality across an increasingly AI\-centric ITSM platform, where automated systems act on data without a human to catch errors first.  

**A data\-capability role, not a security role.** **Core responsibilities — Anchor domain: Service \& asset data (immediate priority)**  

* Ensure existing service mapping is accurate and current across hosts, servers, and applications.
* Extend mapping coverage to data types not well covered today — certificates, websites, agents, and SaaS applications.
* Engage in the workflows that onboard new applications and capabilities into the CMDB so coverage keeps pace rather than drifting.
* Go deeper into discovery and software\-asset tooling — Lansweeper, the software asset management system, and agent\-based discovery — to raise inventory fidelity.
 **Core responsibilities — Broader mandate: Platform \& AI\-consumption data quality**  

* Apply the same discipline to other high\-value platform data — service catalog and metadata, ticket routing and assignment\-group data, and the Dataverse structures underneath delivery capabilities such as the AskIT service chatbot.
* Raise data to the standard AI systems require: complete, disambiguated, and semantically clean, so intent classification, catalog matching, and automated routing act on trustworthy inputs rather than amplifying noise.
* Leverage the existing foundation (Dataverse schema, discovery tooling, search indexes already in place) rather than building net\-new infrastructure.
* Make data consumable without re\-verification \- the test is whether an engineer or an automated agent can act on a record without re\-checking it, and turn recurring data problems into repeatable quality practices.
 **What this role is not**  

* **Not remediation coordination or change management**
* **Not a security function \-** it supplies the data; it does not own security decisions.
* **Not a net\-new platform build \-** leverages and improves the existing foundation.
 **Example Success measures**  

* **Coverage:** % of assets, certificates, websites, agents, and SaaS apps mapped to owner and service; extended over time to other platform data domains.
* **Data confidence:** high enough that implementation teams and AI capabilities don't require re\-verification.
* **Time\-to\-onboard** a new application or capability into the CMDB.
* **Reusability:** improvements delivered as repeatable practices, not one\-off fixes.
 **What You’ll Need:****Education:**  

Bachelor's degree in information systems, computer science, data management, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience. A candidate with a strong track record in CMDB, discovery, or data\-quality work should not be screened out for lack of the exact degree. **Experience:**  

Five to eight years in IT data, configuration/asset management, or a data\-engineering\-adjacent role, including demonstrable ownership of a data domain (not just contributing to one).  **Your Advantage:*** Experience in a Microsoft Power Platform environment (Power Automate, Azure AI Search, or similar).
